name: The Library of Templates
realm: Endless shelves. One scroll fits every kind of book.
lesson: A template lets one definition work for many types: template<typename T> T maxOf(T a, T b). The STL gives ready-made containers and algorithms: map (sorted key->value), set (unique sorted values), and <algorithm> functions like sort.

trial.prompt: Which keyword begins a generic function or class definition?

options: a) key-value pairs sorted by key

boss.prompt: What is T deduced as in twice(2.5)?
boss.code: template<typename T> T twice(T x) { return x + x; }

spell.prompt: Write a template function maxOf(a, b) that returns the larger of two values of the same type.
spell.hint: template<typename T> T maxOf(T a, T b) { return a > b ? a : b; }
